context: Yuki and Hiroshi-boss discuss an industry association.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business briefing; vocabulary (組合/協会/民間/指定/会員) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の協会に、加入しませんか?
lines.en: Shall we join the industry association?
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 協会の会員には、利点があるのかね?
lines.en: Are there benefits to association membership?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会員は、民間の情報を共有できます。
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Is it different from a union?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、組合とは役割が違います。
lines.en: Yes, its role differs from a union's.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 指定の会費は、高いのかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 指定の会費は、手頃な額です。
lines.style: reassuring office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: では、協会の会員になろう。
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm closing clarity throughout
